The workbook generation failed due to Excel #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid formula syntax or missing named ranges.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values (e.g., H46 expected -1.6531688150158277). While the 'net metric' matrix passed, the 'statistics' matrix mismatches suggest that the formulas used for derived stats are not being recognized by the evaluator or are referencing undefined names.
